author: KEXP
description: For decades, Japanese black metal band Sigh have been journeying through waves of dark, experimental soundscapes. In our latest in-studio session, the band transform the Live Room with a performance of "The Transfiguration Fear" and more from across their discography.
title: Sigh performs "The Transfiguration Fear" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Sigh performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded July 29, 2026.

Songs:  
The Transfiguration Fear 00:29
Satsui 4:35
Kuroi Kage 09:06
The Soul Grave 16:55

Mirai Kawashima - Vocals, Shakuhachi
